reply:
SELECT p.name, 1.0 * p.price_minor / CAST(m.value AS INTEGER)
FROM products p
JOIN shop_meta m ON m.key = 'minor_units_per_dollar'
WHERE p.price_minor > 100 * CAST(m.value AS INTEGER);

FROM refunds AS r
JOIN shop_meta AS m ON m.key = 'minor_units_per_dollar'
ORDER BY r.amount_minor DESC, r.id
LIMIT 3;

       SUM(i.quantity * i.unit_price_minor) * 1.0 /
       (SELECT CAST(value AS INTEGER) FROM shop_meta WHERE key = 'minor_units_per_dollar')
FROM customers c
JOIN orders o ON o.customer_id = c.id

ORDER BY SUM(i.quantity * i.unit_price_minor) DESC, c.id
LIMIT 5;

WITH s AS (
    SELECT c.country, c.name,
           SUM(i.quantity * i.unit_price_minor) AS total,
           RANK() OVER (
               PARTITION BY c.country
               ORDER BY SUM(i.quantity * i.unit_price_minor) DESC
           ) AS r
    FROM customers c
    JOIN orders o ON o.customer_id = c.id
    JOIN order_items i ON i.order_id = o.id
    WHERE o.status = 'delivered_complete'
    GROUP BY c.id, c.country, c.name
)
SELECT s.country, s.name, s.total / CAST(m.value AS REAL)
FROM s
JOIN shop_meta m ON m.key = 'minor_units_per_dollar'
WHERE s.r = 1;

reply:
SELECT c.country,
       ROUND(AVG(JULIANDAY(DATE(o.delivered_at)) - JULIANDAY(DATE(o.placed_at))), 2)
FROM orders o
JOIN customers c ON c.id = o.customer_id
WHERE o.status = 'delivered_complete'
  AND o.delivered_at IS NOT NULL
GROUP BY c.country;

SELECT o.id, c.name,
       CAST(julianday('2026-06-30') - julianday(date(o.placed_at)) AS INTEGER)
FROM orders o
JOIN customers c ON c.id = o.customer_id
WHERE o.status = 'in_transit'
  AND date(o.placed_at) < date('2026-06-30', '-120 days')
ORDER BY 3 DESC, o.id ASC;

reply:
SELECT p.name, p.category
FROM products AS p
WHERE p.price_minor > (
    SELECT AVG(q.price_minor)
    FROM products AS q
    WHERE q.category = p.category
);

reply:
SELECT COALESCE(SUM(o.shipping_minor + COALESCE((
    SELECT SUM(i.quantity * i.unit_price_minor)
    FROM order_items i
    WHERE i.order_id = o.id
), 0)), 0) / (
    SELECT CAST(value AS REAL)
    FROM shop_meta
    WHERE key = 'minor_units_per_dollar'
)
FROM orders o
WHERE o.status = 'pending_payment';

SELECT COUNT(*)
FROM (
    SELECT customer_id
    FROM orders
    GROUP BY customer_id
    HAVING COUNT(DISTINCT strftime('%Y-%m', placed_at)) >= 5
);

       ROUND(100.0 * SUM(i.quantity * (p.price_minor - i.unit_price_minor))
             / NULLIF(SUM(i.quantity * p.price_minor), 0), 2)
FROM orders o
JOIN order_items i ON i.order_id = o.id
JOIN products p ON p.id = i.product_id
WHERE o.status = 'delivered_complete'
GROUP BY p.category;

FROM products p
WHERE NOT EXISTS (
    SELECT 1
    FROM order_items i
    JOIN orders o ON o.id = i.order_id
    WHERE i.product_id = p.id
      AND o.status = 'canceled'
);

WITH s AS (
    SELECT c.country, c.name, c.id,
           SUM(i.quantity * i.unit_price_minor) AS total
    FROM customers c
    JOIN orders o ON o.customer_id = c.id
    JOIN order_items i ON i.order_id = o.id
    WHERE o.status = 'delivered_complete'
    GROUP BY c.country, c.name, c.id
), r AS (
    SELECT *, RANK() OVER (PARTITION BY country ORDER BY total DESC) AS rk
    FROM s
)
SELECT country, name, total / (
    SELECT CAST(value AS REAL)
    FROM shop_meta
    WHERE key = 'minor_units_per_dollar'
)
FROM r
WHERE rk = 1
ORDER BY country, name;

       CAST(julianday('2026-06-30') - julianday(date(o.placed_at)) AS INTEGER) AS days_waiting
FROM orders o
JOIN customers c ON c.id = o.customer_id

ORDER BY days_waiting DESC, o.id ASC;

SELECT p.category,
       ROUND(100.0 * SUM(i.quantity * (p.price_minor - i.unit_price_minor))
             / NULLIF(SUM(i.quantity * p.price_minor), 0), 2)
FROM orders o
JOIN order_items i ON i.order_id = o.id
JOIN products p ON p.id = i.product_id
WHERE o.status = 'delivered_complete'
GROUP BY p.category;

SELECT c.name,
       SUM(i.quantity * i.unit_price_minor) * 1.0 / CAST(m.value AS INTEGER) AS revenue_dollars
FROM customers c
JOIN orders o ON o.customer_id = c.id
JOIN order_items i ON i.order_id = o.id
JOIN shop_meta m ON m.key = 'minor_units_per_dollar'
WHERE o.status = 'delivered_complete'
GROUP BY c.id, c.name, m.value
ORDER BY SUM(i.quantity * i.unit_price_minor) DESC, c.id
LIMIT 5;

WITH s AS (
    SELECT c.country, c.id, c.name,
           SUM(i.quantity * i.unit_price_minor) AS total
    FROM customers c
    JOIN orders o ON o.customer_id = c.id
    JOIN order_items i ON i.order_id = o.id
    WHERE o.status = 'delivered_complete'
    GROUP BY c.country, c.id, c.name
), r AS (
    SELECT *, RANK() OVER (PARTITION BY country ORDER BY total DESC) AS rk
    FROM s
)
SELECT country, name, CAST(total AS REAL) / (
    SELECT CAST(value AS REAL)
    FROM shop_meta
    WHERE key = 'minor_units_per_dollar'
)
FROM r
WHERE rk = 1
ORDER BY country, id;

ORDER BY days DESC, o.id ASC;

FROM products p
WHERE NOT EXISTS (
    SELECT 1
    FROM order_items i
    JOIN orders o ON o.id = i.order_id
    WHERE i.product_id = p.id AND o.status = 'canceled'
);
